noticeReconcile: Reconciling Gazettes, GIS Telemetry, and Ward Voices
heroTitle: Know what's happening in your place.
heroSubtitle: Explore infrastructure around you — what is already here, what is being built, what is planned, and what people in your area are asking for.
tellUs: Tell us what your area needs
mapLayer: Active Geographic Layer: Pune–Mumbai Metropolitan Arc
synopsisText: Several transport projects are expanding connectivity along the eastern corridor, while residents have flagged active concerns regarding evening feeder buses and stormwater drainage along low-lying culverts.
hotIssueText: 83 residents signed feeder bus frequency petition for Hadapsar.
fiveQTitle: Five questions every citizen has the right to ask.
fiveQSubtitle: Public works should not hide behind bureaucratic terminology. We translate complex municipal budgets, tender notices, and geospatial master plans into human truths.
ch1Desc: Explore completed flyovers, commissioned metro routes, water treatment plants, and public parks. Review post-completion audits and see how existing assets hold up under seasonal stress.
ch2Desc: Real-time ground visibility on contractor mobilization, physical milestone execution, utility relocations, and honest revised delivery timelines without sugarcoating delays.
ch3Desc: Upcoming alignments, land acquisition status, environmental green clearances, and sanctioned budgetary disbursements before barricades arrive in your neighborhood.
ch4Desc: Community priorities that master plans overlook. Flag dangerous crossings, flood-prone underpasses, absent bus shelters, or lack of footpath connectivity in your native language.
ch5Desc: Every inference connects to an open gazette, state tender portal, or satellite radar pass. No black boxes. Check confidence ratings, ministry reference numbers, and ground audit notes with one click.
explorerTitle: Start with a place you care about.
explorerSubtitle: High-density infrastructure dossiers maintained with continuous citizen updates.
voiceSubtitle: Tell us what is difficult, missing, unsafe, or changing in your neighborhood. Submissions are verified with neighbors and mapped straight to municipal ward works.
voiceIntake: Voice intake enabled in Hindi, Kannada, Marathi, Tamil, Bengali & English via Bhashini AI.
trustDesc1: INFRA-AI collects no personal phone numbers, advertising identifiers, or tracking tokens. Every contribution is geocoded anonymously to protect civic participation.
trustDesc2: All data pipelines map strictly to published union state gazettes, legislative assembly budgetary questions, and public tender awards verified on Open Data standards.
trustDesc3: Maintained as a Digital Public Good (DPG) under open governance principles to ensure permanent public access across all 28 states and 8 union territories.
footerBrandDesc: A sovereign, public-access infrastructure observatory reconciling capital works, spatial planning, and citizen ground truth across Indian states and union territories.
formDescriptionPlaceholder: What is difficult, missing, or unsafe? Be specific about the location and the impact on your daily life.
successDesc: Your neighborhood need has been logged and will be verified with nearby residents. You'll receive updates as it's matched to municipal ward works.

inv.landing.nav.label: Main
inv.landing.headline: Invest where infrastructure already delivers
inv.landing.lead: We rank cities and neighbourhoods across India on what is already on the ground: national highways, metro and rail stations, the main-road network, and how much built-up land has grown since 2000. Every score shows the numbers behind it.
inv.landing.trust: No account, and we never ask who you are.
inv.landing.sample.title: Top cities in Maharashtra
inv.landing.sample.sub: Live from the data, on the Balanced preset. Scores are out of 100.
inv.landing.sample.empty: No city to show here yet. Start with any state instead.
inv.landing.how.title: How it works
inv.landing.how.1.title: Pick where you are looking
inv.landing.how.1.body: Choose a state, or search for a city by name. Nothing personal is asked.
inv.landing.how.2.title: Say what matters most
inv.landing.how.2.body: Daily commute, highway access or growth so far. Each preset is a set of weights you can read.
inv.landing.how.3.title: Compare with the reasons
inv.landing.how.3.body: See the top five cities, then the best areas of each on a hexagon map, with the facts behind every score.
inv.landing.measure.title: What we measure
inv.landing.measure.lead: Five factors from open data that covers every city in India, in two groups.
inv.landing.measure.access.body: How easily people and goods get in and out.
inv.landing.measure.highways.desc: Distance to the nearest national highway or expressway.
inv.landing.measure.transit.desc: Distance to the nearest metro station and the nearest railway station.
inv.landing.measure.roads.desc: Kilometres of main road per square kilometre.
inv.landing.measure.momentum.body: How much the place has already grown.
inv.landing.measure.growth.desc: Change in the share of built-up land from 2000 to 2020, measured from satellite data.
inv.landing.measure.unit: Each area is a hexagon of about 5 km². A factor we could not measure is left out and shown as a dash, never counted as zero.
inv.landing.not.title: What this is not
inv.landing.not.forecast.title: Not a forecast
inv.landing.not.forecast.body: We describe what exists today and what has already changed. We do not predict what happens next.
inv.landing.not.price.title: Not a price guide
inv.landing.not.price.body: There are no prices, rents or valuations here, because no open source covers them for every city.
inv.landing.not.advice.title: Not financial advice
inv.landing.not.advice.body: Use it to shortlist places to visit and check for yourself. Speak to a registered adviser before you commit money.
inv.landing.sources.title: Sources and licenses
inv.landing.sources.lead: Open data only. Every score keeps the source, date and license of the facts behind it.
inv.landing.final.title: Start with a state you know
inv.landing.final.body: Three short questions, then a ranked list with reasons.
